results.title: GitHub Terms of Service - GitHub Docs
results.snippet: GitHub will provide notice regarding our access to private repository content, unless for legal disclosure, to comply with our legal obligations, or where otherwise bound by requirements under law, for automated scanning, or if in response to a security threat or other risk to security.

results.title: GitHub Acceptable Use Policies - GitHub Docs
results.snippet: Scraping refers to extracting information from our Service via an automated process, such as a bot or webcrawler. Scraping does not refer to the collection of information through our API.

results.title: GitHub Terms for Additional Products and Features - GitHub Docs
results.snippet: From April 1, 2025, features that were previously only available under a single GitHub Advanced Security license will be alternatively available under two separate licenses: GitHub Code Security (code scanning and dependency scanning features) ...

results.title: GitHub Corporate Terms of Service - GitHub Docs
results.snippet: “Scraping” means extracting data from the Service via an automated process, such as a bot or webcrawler, and does not include the collection of information through GitHub's API.

results.title: REST API endpoints for code scanning - GitHub Docs
results.snippet: You can retrieve and update code scanning alerts from a repository. You can use the endpoints to create automated reports for the code scanning alerts in an organization or upload analysis results generated using offline code scanning tools.
